summary: The D.C. Elections Board has asked the National Guard to stay away from ballot drop boxes, part of ongoing concerns about the National Guard's role in the District. Advocates say the presence of National Guard troops in D.C. raises questions about local autonomy, and statehood supporters have documented what they characterize as multiple attacks on the District's local authority. A U.S. senator has committed to making D.C. statehood a top priority. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.
